class_label: toilet tissue, toilet paper, bathroom tissue
focus_areas: Legibility and origin of the black text-like markings on the roll (Text Gibberish).
Physical plausibility of the hanging paper's drape and texture (Texture Anomaly).
Edge definition between the white paper and the dark background (Topology/Boundary).
Spatial grounding of the roll and bin via bounding box detection (OVD).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the black markings on the left side of the roll. Use the image_text_auditor to determine if they are recognizable letters/branding or exhibit the 'melting' characteristic of AI-generated text. Evaluate if the hanging paper strip has sufficient structural detail (folds, transparency hints) to be considered real, or if it looks like a flat, painted texture. Ensure the open_vocabulary_detector correctly isolates the roll and bin to support the topology audit.
image_description: A roll of white toilet paper is mounted on a dark wall holder. A strip of the paper hangs down into a small, cylindrical, off-white waste bin positioned directly below it on a dark tiled floor. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting shadows inside the bin and behind the roll. There are faint, illegible black markings on the side of the roll.
